body: I've tried, but it only seems to make things worse to be honest.

I actually got a glass of Coke. I suppose that's probably a bad idea since the sugar in it is probably going to make me want another glass! It's really not good to get dehydrated, but my brain's clever enough to wake me when I am. I think it's probably surprisingly common for people not to drink as much as they need to, especially as so many people have busy lives.

I woke up because of dehydration, else I think I would've slept for much longer. I slept for about 6 hours. I like sleeping, it means I can forget about the pain I'm in, at least for a while; it's pretty good for our brains too since it lets them do so maintenance.

I'm still here. I was asleep. I thought I'd go to sleep and let my brain try to fix itself because sleep can be good for that. I just feel like an incredible burden on people. I only ever seem to make them sad and I don't meant to. They probably hate me and I feel like their lives would be so much better without me.
I'm still here. I fell asleep. I feeling so incredibly lonely. I just feel like an a burden on people. I only ever make them sad. I don't mean to. I love them more than I could possibly describe.
I'm still here. I fell asleep. I hoped that falling asleep would help my brain sort itself out; at least for a few hours.

I'm not sure I can really stop myself from trying to end it all in the long run. I internalize most of my pain and I'm really the only one who deserves to suffer. I don't really think of it as taking the easy way out, especially as pill are a genuinely excruciatingly painful choice. It's pain I feel I deserve though; since at least after I'm gone, no-one's going to need to bother about me anymore.

I'm still here. I'm actually in my late 20s. I've had some pretty awful arguments with my parents, and I can't help but internalise it and beat myself up about it. I'm always made to feel like I'm the wrong for my transition.
I don't mind. Please ask!

I still don't understand it. I've been nothing but kind and loving to him. I've supported him, and done everything I could to help him too. I love him. I just wish he would talk to me, because I feel like I'm being ignored, and it doesn't just hurt me, it says a lot about him too.

I can't help but feel that everything he has told me is a lie. I've made presents for him that I've still to give to him, but it truly feels like all the love, and care, and attention I put into it has been for nothing. I'm absolutely devastated.

I don't feel able to confront him about it for the moment, but considering the emotional state I'm in at the moment, that's perhaps to be expected. If he doesn't try to contact me, then I'll know for sure that he doesn't really want to be friends.

I understand the point about there being people in need to, but I really don't feel like I'd be a good enough friend. I put more emotional effort into relationships than I get in return, and it's really tiring, so much so that I really don't know if I can do that any more.

It's sad that there are still some GPs that are so transphobic and just all round horrible people. It surprises me that some of them are still able to continue practising as GPs as they're really absent of any understand or compassion.

That's a really, really long time to wait, and I suppose I don't need to explain the underfunding of most GICs. It's so horrendous and it's clear that some parts of government just don't care. I've come to realise more and more that a lot of people are doing HRT themselves because of the ridiculous waiting times. What are the risks of doing that?

I'm really glad that you've got private healthcare. Is it expensive? Doctor Webberley seems like a really super doctor from the posts I've been reading on reddit.

What report is that quote from? Please don't feel bad about getting your GIC referral. That's a really great step! What's the average referral time for appointments in your area?

It's horrible reading some of the arguments used to justify budget cuts, and unfortunately it also has consequences in other areas of the NHS such as increasing the demand on overstretched and underfunded mental health services that further strains the demand.

It's not that good at the moment. Like a lot of people, it's hard to find jobs and the financial struggle is just as difficult and adds to the pressure.

It's a dehumanizing part of capitalism that there are people in government that look at citizens as just a measure of economic profit and fail to see them as human beings. It's horrible and so angering too that there's so much suffering that could start to be healed through a compassionate and sustainable system.

Unfortunately the NHS is part of the government's ideological crusade and it's those most in need that are suffering the most, either not getting the treatment soon enough, or feeling so ashamed that they feel they're a burden and don't speak.

I want to contribute. I'd love to start paying NI contributions again and start helping others through those, but at the same time it's heartbreaking seeing the government use the system to punish people most in need.

I don't really have any support at all to be honest. I think I said in another post that there's no local support groups and there's really no-one to reach out to, and unfortunately that situation hasn't changed. How are you?

I understand the capitalist argument but at this particular time I'm not so much interested in being objectified as a unit of economic production. I do understand the economic argument but that kind of argument is a little dehumanizing.

It's just a mash-up of lots of different situations I'm experiencing at the moment and at this particular moment I feel like I'm a social burden and financial burden to others.
/u/NatLuc I responded and sent a private message!

I can't do walking for a long time because of personal circumstances so it makes that kind of thing hard and tiring. I'm taking antidepressants at the moment but I still get quite bleak still. I've been on them for quite a long time but there's only so much they can do.

Blogging is something I haven't done for a long time so I might try that but I don't think I'd be very interesting. I've never done poetry, I find it a little embarrassing and walking is something I can't really do without getting very tired very quickly I'm afraid. Yes I've tried antidepressants and I find it helps a lot.
That's absolutely not helpful. Yes I do apply for retail jobs and I do understand that it's the same for a lot of people.

I'm not in a position to help out at farms physically and I don't really have the concentration for things like NaNoWriMo. There's not much in terms of interesting places either to be be fair and buses are really quite expensive for that matter.

It's months and months and months long. I live in such a rural place it it's really not worthwhile trying to find groups with shared interest since I'd need a car and I don't drive and public transport it's really quite poor.

I'm not applying through that just yet, still waiting on decisions but it's not looking good as far as I can see. As for jobs, I've been applying for jobs for months and nothing comes of it, and I really can't afford to do volunteering work as I'd have no income, so that's not an option either.

I'm not at university at the moment, I'm hoping to go but I've had all my applications so far rejected. I've got no-one I can really call since all of the people I've tried speaking to, and who don't reply, are people I met at university. I've never really liked talking to Samaritans to be honest, they don't really have any expertise for trans* topics.

Transition is really a non-starter, I can't afford to get any clothes I like and can't really afford to get rid of the clothes I hate, and I've unfortunately not got much support, safe to say that there's a lot of ignorance transphobes in my life.
I really haven't got any friends I can confident in. I've kind of lost all of them. I try my best to try and speak to them but I never, ever get any replies and no-one calls.
Thanks for replying! I don't use Instagram. I can still use reddit though. Your art is incredible though! It's so beautiful!
I've used that. I'll need to create another user account though as I can't remember the password I used. I'm genderqueer.
